title: Qt: Add plugin description/homepage fields to About dialog
description:
Adds the description and homepage columns to the TableView in
the "About Wireshark" plugins tab.

Currently extcap and lua scripts lack this information, this
could be improved in the future.

notes.body: I considered remove the "Path" column and adding a "License" column but did not.
